note: The desk's project registry. One stanza per project. Copy this file to projects.json and edit, or register a project with `setsweep add <folder>` (CLI) or the GUI's 'add project' flow. Each project's .setsweep/ desk (charter, memory, queue, logs) is created on first selection. Fields: id (unique slug), name (display), root (the agent's working dir; ~ is honored), kit (curator playbook — writing|code|records|knowledge|inbox, or omit for a general curator), optional role (per-project system prompt for the review agent), optional intake (inbox kind only: a watched folder that auto-curates new files into the queue).
